articles.title: Pentagon seeks expertise to develop brain injury assessment standards
articles.summary: The Defense Department is seeking a variety of information that can help in formulating standards for assessing mild traumatic brain injuries, or mTBI.

articles.title: VIDEO: F-35C Lands on New Navy Aircraft Carrier Class for First Time
articles.summary: A fifth-generation fighter landed on the Navy’s new class of aircraft carriers for the first time on Tuesday. An F-35C Joint Strike Fighter Lightning II trapped on the future USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79), according to U.S. Navy video and imagery.

articles.title: Navy Contracts Ursa Major to Develop Rocket Motors for Next-gen Missile Programs
articles.summary: The U.S. Navy contracted Ursa Major to develop solid rocket motors for the sea service’s future Naval Modular Missile and Compact Air-to-Air Missile, the defense firm announced last week.
